description.value: An issue that arose while the expansion was being produced, that users of the expansion should know about - for example, that the expansion does not list all the codes that were asked for, and why. The issue is an OperationOutcome contained in the ValueSet, with a single issue, that this extension refers to.

purpose.value: Servers sometimes can't return the expansion that was asked for: a code system's licence may limit how many of its codes an expansion can list, or some codes may not be available. The total and the valueset-unclosed extension say that the expansion is not all the codes, but not why; this extension carries the explanation, in the same form as other errors and warnings servers return (OperationOutcome.issue), so that it can be coded (issue type, details) and displayed to users.

short.value: An issue users of the expansion should know about

definition.value: An issue that arose while the expansion was being produced, that users of the expansion should know about - for example, that the expansion does not list all the codes that were asked for, and why. The issue is an OperationOutcome contained in the ValueSet, with a single issue, that this extension refers to.

comment.value: Each issue is a separate contained OperationOutcome, with a single issue, and a separate repeat of this extension. The issue should have a details.coding from http://hl7.org/fhir/tools/CodeSystem/tx-issue-type, and details.text that can be shown to users; it may have a message id (http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/operationoutcome-message-id). Issues that prevent the expansion being produced at all are returned as an OperationOutcome in place of the expansion, not with this extension.

short.value: The contained OperationOutcome with the issue
